title: [GMCP 203.010.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Complete resource server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-010-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Static and templated resources support deterministic discovery, URI completion, text and binary reads, metadata, pagination/filtering, cache semantics, list and update notifications, modern filtered subscriptions, authorization, cancellation, and bounded streaming. URI-template matching, traversal, races, stale cache, not-found semantics, MIME handling, and large-resource behavior pass positive and adversarial fixtures. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
